annotations.title: Admissions game: the meeting and vote

description: App-only stage of admissions_game, called by the in-chat view after every reader has finished. The fictional committee discusses the readers' notes and votes Accept, Waitlist or Deny under the school's round, and returns the conversation and the vote. Simulation only.

application.description: The student's own application text (essays, activities, grades) exactly as they supplied it. Used for this run only; never stored.

major.description: Intended major, if the student gave one.

readers.description: Every reader's notes from game_read, keyed by reader.

run.description: The run state returned by admissions_game (seating, readers and ids). Pass it back unchanged.

school.description: The college the application is for, as the student named it (e.g. "Tufts").

visits.description: Any campus visits or contact with the college the student mentioned.
